This is what you need to know. This is episode nr 21 of The Marathon Podcast. Yesterday, the Boston Athletics Association made some big changes to how to qualify for The Boston Marathon 2027. It's a big change as there will be less races to run in order to qualify for Boston Marathon going forward. In this episode of The Marathon Podcast we are going through these changes and what they mean for you. I never thought I'd run a marathon. As a former speed skater I never thought I would go all in on running. Yet, here I am, trying to run my first marathon. And the goal is a sub 3 hour marathon. More precisely 2.55, and qualify for the Boston Marathon 2025. Eric Floberg's Floberg Runs channel has been a huge inspiration.
